name: ANSI/IEEE Delta-delta transformer form
summary: IEEE-library form of delta-delta transformer: a delta-delta transformer uses delta-connected windings on both sides.
description: This reference locates delta-delta transformer in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase transformers family. A delta-delta transformer uses delta-connected windings on both sides. The drawing communicates the winding connections while the vector group and device ratings specify the actual transformer arrangement. The public library uses HXF1T13 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.

Check phase-displacement notation when interconnecting supplies. Two delta windings do not provide a star neutral point. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
